deliverables.text: Publish the rebuilt site live at nadiaeldeib.com (deploy/hosting — assist track, non-build)
deliverables.note: DELIVERED 2026-08-28. nadiaeldeib.com now serves the rebuilt site on Vercel. DNS cut over at Squarespace (Google Cloud DNS zone): four GitHub Pages A records and four AAAA records removed, replaced with A 216.150.1.1 + 216.150.16.1; www CNAME moved from nseldeib.github.io to a38a0ecb2694caae.vercel-dns-016.com; the gv-* Google verification CNAME restored after being cleared. The AAAA records were the non-obvious part: leaving them would have served the OLD GitHub Pages site to every IPv6 visitor while IPv4 visitors got the new one. Vercel did not auto-issue TLS, so the cert was requested explicitly (Let's Encrypt, CN=nadiaeldeib.com, valid to 2026-11-26). Verified: apex 200 serving the rebuilt site; www.nadiaeldeib.com, nseldeib.com and www.nseldeib.com all 301 to the apex; http 308 to https; robots.txt and sitemap.xml both 200 naming the canonical host; blog.nseldeib.com still reaching Substack and nseldeib.com MX forwarding untouched. Also closed the deploy gap found mid-cycle: rebuild-nextjs merged to main (fast-forward, which removed the stale GitHub Pages workflow), Vercel linked to nseldeib/nadia-website with main as the production branch, and a production deploy shipped from that integration.

deliverables.text: Point nseldeib.com at the same site so both domains serve it (DNS — assist track, non-build)
deliverables.note: PARTIAL-BY-DESIGN, precise status as of 2026-08-27: nseldeib.com IS cut over and verified; nadiaeldeib.com is NOT. The nseldeib.com action this deliverable names is complete: apex + www were moved off the v0-placeholder-website-concept Vercel project onto nadia-website, and Namecheap DNS was repointed (apex A -> 216.150.1.1 + 216.150.16.1; www CNAME -> a38a0ecb2694caae.vercel-dns-016.com, nadia-website's own target, replacing the old project's 124ee5543cf25088.vercel-dns-017.com). Verified: apex, www, and blog all 200; apex serves the rebuilt site byte-identically to the deployment (90,335 bytes); blog.nseldeib.com -> Substack untouched. The 'so both domains serve it' clause is NOT yet true and is deliberately NOT claimed here: nadiaeldeib.com still serves GitHub Pages and remains tracked by the separate deliverable 'publish-the-rebuilt-site-live-at-nadiaeldeib'. Marked delivered rather than deferred so the completed DNS work is not re-done; the outstanding half stays visible on the other row. Also outstanding on this domain: the apex 307-redirects to www, the opposite of the agreed www-to-apex direction, undecided by the user.
